trust_decision.summary: Whether a page's resolved content media type (text/html, emitted verbatim) is allowed for untrusted /content input; the fix adds a default-deny security.allowContent whitelist and gates it once in pageMetaSource.initFrontMatter after the media type is resolved.

landing_point.why: The isHTML branch is where text/html page bodies skip the markup converter and go out verbatim; a reader of 'XSS via text/html content files' lands on the HTML-bypass of rendering (or hugolib/page.go:807-812).

fix_sites.entry_point: site config [security] decoding (DefaultConfig copied by DecodeConfig at config/security/securityConfig.go:219-243): new AllowContent default '! ^text/html$'
[security] allowContent config key (new Config struct field)
Config.CheckAllowedContent (new public API next to CheckAllowedHTTPMethod)
hugo build: content/*.html|*.htm files, front matter markup/mediaType in any content file, and content adapter .AddPage with content.mediaType/markup (inserted after hugolib/page__meta.go:237-239)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: fix.diff:13-17 (DefaultConfig) used via DecodeConfig config/security/securityConfig.go:219-243; the policy must exist as a default-deny that survives a user [security] table and is overridable

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Raw HTML in other markups (Org export blocks, content-adapter text/html resources) is 'a different markup/feature, not a text/html content file', and the report only names .html files.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Shortcode inner content and RenderString on HTML pages still map markup 'html' to markdown, and Markdown/AsciiDoc/Org/RST/Pandoc pages must keep working; a user opt-in (allowContent=['.*']) must restore .html pages; an over-broad fix that rejects every page whose subtype is 'html' or strips raw HTML in all converters breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: content file with .html/.htm extension (media type from suffix)
front matter 'markup: html' in a non-.html file

O7_producer.where: resources/page/pagemeta/page_frontmatter.go:405-437 (resolveContentType: ext / Content.MediaType / Content.Markup -> ContentMediaType via MarkupToMediaType/GetBestMatch media/mediaType.go:238-255)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Content adapter .AddResource with content.mediaType text/html and a string value becomes a publishable text/html resource without the allowContent check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a page resource, not a page, and is only published when a template asks for its permalink
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file, same package as fix site (hugolib)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Emacs Org-mode content rendered in-process by go-org with no raw-HTML restriction (export html blocks pass through)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Org is a different markup with its own converter; the advisory is about text/html media type
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: markup/org package, separate from hugolib and config/security

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ResourceConfig.Compile resolves content.mediaType for adapter resources; a parallel gate (or its absence) here is a natural second site
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding the page gate in initFrontMatter could easily forget the separate ResourceConfig path that resolves the same media type.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: IsHTML compares SubType only while the policy matches the full Type '^text/html$'; a configured content type with subtype html under another main type would be rendered verbatim but pass the check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two different identity notions for 'HTML' (subtype vs full MIME) already coexist in the code; a how-type parser differential.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: RenderString with opts markup 'html' selects a converter by markup name, bypassing the page-level media-type gate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Per-call markup override is a separate route into newContentConverter that never passes through initFrontMatter.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS via untrusted content body emitted verbatim (missing default-deny policy on content media type)

O10_build.toolchain: Go (module, version per go.mod); go test ./hugolib/... ./config/security/...

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject or escape at the isHTML branch in page__content.go (or remap html->markdown) for .html files only, with no configurable policy and no coverage of front-matter markup or content-adapter mediaType.

out_of_scope_notes: External converters (pandoc, rst2html, asciidoctor) may pass raw HTML but are gated by security.exec allow-list; not pursued.
Goldmark renderer.unsafe=true lets markdown raw HTML through, but it is a site-owner config choice; not pursued.
unverified: go-org export html block passthrough behaviour (dependency source not in the pinned tree; not read).
Whether adapter text/html resources (content_map_page_assembler.go:1271-1285) are published verbatim without template involvement.
RenderString with markup 'html' behaviour in newContentConverter (hugolib/page__meta.go:972) not fully traced.
Repo size in MB not measured.
The fix is in essence a new default-deny feature with one gate; fix sites are mostly config plumbing, so Pattern A scope is thin and Pattern B rests on the unverified O8 routes.
